comparison_method: Difference of arithmetic mean bucket group-wall rates. Within band = larger of baseline and candidate maximum absolute r0-r1 difference within one arm. Full band = larger of baseline and candidate full max-min range across all observed repeats/arms. Absolute mean difference strictly greater than band is descriptive exceedance only, not significance, confidence, or tuning proof.

limitations: Fixed reload order, no independent window replication/randomization.
r0 solo-before-dual, r1 dual-before-solo: cache/order and MTP paths differ.
Probed baseline first and explicit 0.25 last are different startup modes/order positions; not pooled.
API/native timing and hit/PCIe counters may be segment scoped; hit denominator changes with configured split.
